summary: For this LS setup, the reliable connector-safe review route is a same-repository command PR handled by a pull_request workflow.

claims.claim: The pull_request command PR route produced a visible source diagnostic, target acknowledgement, Grok review, and target result.
Earlier comment-based and branch-push command routes did not provide a reliable visible acknowledgement in this connector setup.

evidence.description: Internet CI / CI Node Mesh epic.
